notes.title: v1.10 Free building placement
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.1.png[/img]

[b]Feature[/b]
Free building placement: 
Except the resource center, other base buildings can be placed freely on the map. 

Improved ground vehicle destroyed effect: 
When the ground vehicles are destroyed, this camouflage will change into rust color, and the heavy vehicles may have a chance to burn for a while before explosion. 

[b]New Building [/b]
Firebase: 
The dozer can build the firebase which can garrison at most 4 infantries, and it can call the helicopter to carry a missile turret or even howitzer on it.

notes.title: v1.05: Performance optimized, Sound volume bug fixed.
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.1.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
The game sound is now at normal level, the volume is much higher than the last version, please adjust the sound volume in desktop or option menu.

In the Armory, vehicles rotation is now right on the game setting of low, normal and high.

In the Armory, the prices of mercenary units are now shown as "Free".


[b]Balance[/b]
AH-64's attack speed increased 100%, but damage decreased to 50%.
UH-60's damage decreased from 8 to 6.

notes.title: Upgrade 1.04: Improved unit selection, new APC BTR-80
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/screen_apc2.jpg[/img]

[b]Units[/b]
BTR-80: A power light armor vehicle that can attack both ground and air enemies with fast auto cannon.

[b]Features[/b]
A new multi-unit select UI, help the player to select multiple ground and air units by dragging the vive controller.

[b]Tip[/b]
If your monitor resolution is not typical in 16:9, 16:10 or 4:3, like 2560 * 1080, please try to select 1024*768 in the config dialog to prevent some error.

notes.title: Hotfix2: Improved VR UI
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/screen.jpg[/img]

1. Change the UI, for fit for the VR control in both combat and base building.

2. Menu button (the button above the round panel in the Vive controller) now worked as hot key: One click to cancel current selection and select all combat units, and double click to auto pick the factory.

3. New armory UI and back ground, more shock in VR.

notes.title: Hotfix: About Camera
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.1.png[/img]

After seeing the VOD and feedback from players, I made the hotfix to change the camera move and angle.

1. Camera move is now instant transport, more fit for the VR. Just use the round panel in the right handler of Vive to move the camera.

2. Camera angle fixed, now the ground in the game is parallel to the ground.

notes.title: Armor Clash VR version 1.03
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.1.png[/img]

Balance: 
Reduce the HP of base guard tower and firebase from 2500 to 1500. 
Reduce the damage of base guard tower from 15 to 12. 
Slower the attack speed of base guard tower. 
Reduce the building speed of main structures from 30 sec to 20 sec. 
Reduce the HP of flak truck from 450 to 425 
Reduce the cost of ATV from 700 to 600. 
Reduce the cost of Hummv from 600 to 500. 
Increase the damage of T-95 Black Eagle from 210 to 225. 
Reduce the Rapid Repair cool down time from 150 sec to 120 sec. 

Bug fix: 
Fix the bug that the base guard tower can be cancelled and return funds. 
Fix the bug that when vehicles are attacking a building while on attack moving, it can not switch attack target by manual order. 

Feature: 
New capsule and icon for the game. 
More help text and icons on building platform, mercenary camps and flag points.
